title: Before the Doors Open
credit: Built on Robert's preview rewrite (preview-stories-e4e6722). Lines and reflections revised for a first-time player.

intro.kicker: Your team's exhibit · one minute before the doors open
intro.text: A paper city where a wave of your hand over a sensor makes a tower rise. It worked in rehearsal. Just now, it fired twice. A queue is already waiting outside.

cast.name: Dev
cast.role: built the sensor; mortified it's glitching

cast.name: Lio
cast.role: promised visitors they could try it; has a perfect rehearsal recording

prompt: The doors are opening. The real thing, or the reliable thing?

setup.line: One minute to opening. A hand passes over the sensor. The tower should rise once.

setup.speaker: Dev
setup.line: Twice. Again. One hand, two triggers. I swear I fixed this last night.
setup.direction: frustrated and embarrassed, almost laughing at himself

setup.speaker: Lio
setup.line: There's a queue outside. I told them they could try it. We've got the rehearsal recording, though. It's perfect.
setup.direction: anxious, talking fast, offering a way out

setup.speaker: Dev
setup.line: I can stand by the reset all afternoon. But it might double again. Please don't tell them it's fixed.

setup.speaker: You
setup.line: I won't. Whatever we do, we tell them the truth about it.

live.speaker: You
live.line: Dev, stay on the reset. Lio, one visitor at a time. I'll explain.

live.speaker: You
live.line: This is a working prototype. Sometimes it counts twice and we have to reset. Still want a go?
The visitor waves. The tower springs up. Twice.

live.speaker: You
live.line: That's the one we're chasing. Want to reset it with Dev and go again?
live.direction: light, turning it into an invitation

live.line: The visitor helps reset. Second try: the tower rises once. They grin. Behind them, the queue has grown.

rehearsal.speaker: You
rehearsal.line: We're showing a recording from rehearsal. The live sensor isn't ready yet, and we'll tell you why.
On the screen, the city rises perfectly. On the table, the real one stays still.

rehearsal.speaker: Visitor
rehearsal.line: Oh. I wanted to try it myself.

rehearsal.speaker: Dev
rehearsal.line: I'm sorry. I can show you how it works inside. It's just not ready for hands yet.
rehearsal.direction: sincere, eager to share the mechanism

rehearsal.line: The visitor leans in to look. The recording loops again.

lesson: Telling the truth is non-negotiable either way. The real choice is which risk your team can carry: a failure in public, or a promise you can't keep today.

live.title: You opened the real thing.
live.kept: Participation and honesty: visitors touched the actual work, flaws and all.
live.cost: A glitch in public, a growing queue, and Dev on the spot all afternoon.
live.ask: When would you stop the live demo, and who gets to call it?

rehearsal.title: You opened the reliable thing.
rehearsal.kept: A clean first showing, honestly labelled, and the team's nerve.
rehearsal.cost: The hands-on moment people came for. Lio's promise couldn't be kept today.
rehearsal.ask: What will you promise about the live version, and how will you keep it?

live.label: Run it live
live.hint: Visitors try the real one, glitch and all.

rehearsal.label: Play the rehearsal
rehearsal.hint: The perfect recording, labelled as one.
